title: First 105 lb Bench Work Sets

context.notes: Late-night push session followed by 15 minutes in a sauna. No numeric 0–6 readiness or pain ratings were supplied.

exercises.name: Smith-Machine Flat Bench
exercises.notes: First full three-set result at 105 lb: 17 completed repetitions and 1,785 lb completed volume. This is one repetition short of the 105 lb × 6, 6, 6 milestone. No failed bench repetition was reported, but RIR and execution quality were not supplied.

sets.notes: Failed while attempting the fifth repetition after four completed repetitions.

exercises.notes: Four completed repetitions followed by one failed repetition attempt. This was one set after the first full 105 lb flat-bench session, so it is preserved as a fatigue-affected observation rather than treated as a matched regression from September 7.

exercises.notes: Equipment, attachment, and per-side loading were not supplied, so the entered load is preserved without further inference.

notes: Workout started at 9:45 PM local time on September 14 and lasted 60 minutes. It contained 20 completed sets, 161 completed repetitions, and 4,555 lb of preserved entered-load volume. The failed fifth incline repetition is recorded separately and excluded from completed repetitions and volume. A 15-minute sauna followed the workout and is recorded separately from lifting duration and volume. No RIR, pain, sleep, energy, soreness, or illness scores were supplied.
